name: calc
title: Calculator
description: Evaluates what you type: arithmetic, units, currencies, percentages, dates and time zones.
author: pal

settings.label: Precision
settings.description: Significant digits in a result; integers are never rounded, units and rates show at most 6.

settings.label: Locale
settings.description: How numbers and dates are written (en: 1,234.5; tr: 1.234,5; de: 1.234,5). Also how a typed number is read.

settings.label: Home currency
settings.description: What a bare amount (12 usd) converts to. Empty: the time zone's currency.

store.tagline: Sums, units, currencies, dates and time zones as you type
features: Arithmetic with precedence, percentages, powers, factorials and bases: `2^10`, `15% of 240`, `255 to hex`
Units through mathjs plus the spellings people type: `5 km to miles`, `72 f to c`, `12 gb to mb`, `5 ft 3 in to cm`
The 30 ECB currencies by code, symbol or name (`12 usd to try`, `€12 to $`, `1k usd`), rates fetched once a day and cached
Dates and durations: `today + 3 days`, `days until 2026-12-25`, `weeks between 2025-06-15 and 2026-01-01`
Time zones by city, abbreviation or offset: `10:00 utc to tokyo`, `5pm ldn in sf`, `now in utc`
A second row with the other form: the reverse conversion, a fraction, the hex and binary of an integer, the ISO date

screenshots.caption: 12 usd to try at the ECB's rate; the reverse conversion is the second row
A day count, with the weeks and months on the right
10:00 UTC in Tokyo, the full date there as the second row
What a result can do: copy, paste into the app in front, copy without formatting

actions.title: Paste result
actions.description: Into the app that was in front.

calc.description: Type an expression; the result is the row. At the root, sums, conversions and dates answer inline under a Calculator section; a query that is none of those gets an Ask Calculator fallback row.
